description: Browse or keyword-search UNICEF's datasets (dataflows). UNICEF Data covers child health, nutrition, education, child protection, child mortality, child poverty, immunization, water/sanitation/hygiene (WASH) and the child-related SDGs. Each result has an `id` (the dataflowId you pass to dataflow_structure / get_data), a `version`, and an English name. There are ~70 datasets; pass `query` to filter. Example: list_dataflows({ query: "mortality" }) or list_dataflows({ query: "nutrition" }).

query.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on dataset id or name, e.g. "mortality", "education", "immunization".

name: list_dataflows
title: List Dataflows
